# modern-charts

> Composable, framework-agnostic Web Component charting library inspired by Nivo and Apache ECharts, powered exclusively by `d3` and `@chenglou/pretext`. Zero framework lock-in: runs natively in Vanilla HTML, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and Solid via standard Custom Elements (`<mc-*-chart>`).

## Quick Rules for AI Code Generation

1. **Prefer per-chart subpath imports** for tree-shaking (41–46% smaller bundle):
   `import 'modern-charts/bar';` (or `line`, `pie`, `heatmap`, `radar`, `sunburst`, `sankey`, `scatter`, `treemap`, `gauge`, `core`).
   Use `import 'modern-charts';` only when rendering multiple unknown chart types or needing the full `d3` namespace on `ctx.d3`.
2. **Always give the host element an explicit height** (or `config.height`), e.g. `<mc-bar-chart style="width: 100%; height: 400px;"></mc-bar-chart>`.
3. **Configure everything via a single `chart.config = { ... }` object** (data, theme, scales, view/zoom, animation, markers, labels, ARIA, layers). Never mutate nested properties in place without reassigning `chart.config` or calling `chart.render()`.
4. **Never invent unsupported layer names** — use only the exact `defaultLayers` listed per chart (plus custom layer functions `(ctx) => SVGElement | string | void` or `{ name, render }`).
5. **Match the exact `data` shape** for the chosen chart (see matrix below and per-chart specs in `charts/*.md`).
6. **Progressive AI streaming**: Call `chart.streamLayers()` (or append `<mc-chart-layer name="...">` children sequentially) to animate layers onto the canvas step-by-step during LLM streaming responses.
7. **Internationalization**: import `configureI18n` from `modern-charts/core` for global defaults, or set `config.i18n = { locale, timeZone, direction, messages }` per chart. Defaults are en-US, runtime local timezone, ltr, and English messages. Custom layers use `ctx.i18n` formatNumber/formatDate/formatPercent/message helpers; numeric data and scales keep their original values. Use `timeZone: 'UTC'` for reproducible date labels.
8. **Feature flags** default to `{ zoom: false, csvExport: false, chartState: true }`. Set `features.chartState: false` at registration to skip the loading and empty overlays. The chart still reports its state and emits `mc-state-change`. [Feature Bootstrapping](./architecture.md#feature-bootstrapping)

## Chart Selection Matrix (All 10 Charts)

| User Intent / Data Shape | Tag | Subpath Import | Data Type | Spec |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Categorical comparison, grouped/stacked/diverging bars | `<mc-bar-chart>` | `modern-charts/bar` | `BarDatum[]` (`{ [indexBy]: string, [key]: number }[]`) | [charts/bar.md](./charts/bar.md) |
| Time-series, trends, multi-series curves, stacked area | `<mc-line-chart>` | `modern-charts/line` | `LineSeries[]` (`{ id, color?, data: { x, y, label? }[] }[]`) | [charts/line.md](./charts/line.md) |
| Part-to-whole proportions, donut KPI breakdown | `<mc-pie-chart>` | `modern-charts/pie` | `PieDatum[]` (`{ id, label?, value, color? }[]`) | [charts/pie.md](./charts/pie.md) |
| 2D matrix intensity, correlation grid, calendar/schedule density | `<mc-heatmap-chart>` | `modern-charts/heatmap` | `HeatmapRow[]` (`{ id, data: { x, y }[] }[]`) | [charts/heatmap.md](./charts/heatmap.md) |
| Multi-dimensional profile comparison across shared metrics | `<mc-radar-chart>` | `modern-charts/radar` | `RadarDatum[]` (`{ [indexBy]: string, [key]: number }[]`) | [charts/radar.md](./charts/radar.md) |
| Multi-level radial hierarchy with interactive drilldown | `<mc-sunburst-chart>` | `modern-charts/sunburst` | `HierarchyNode` (`{ name, value?, color?, children? }`) | [charts/sunburst.md](./charts/sunburst.md) |
| Directed flow volume between stages/nodes (DAG) | `<mc-sankey-chart>` | `modern-charts/sankey` | `SankeyData` (`{ nodes: { id, name?, color? }[], links: { source, target, value }[] }`) | [charts/sankey.md](./charts/sankey.md) |
| Correlation, clusters, bubble plots, linear regression trendline | `<mc-scatter-chart>` | `modern-charts/scatter` | `ScatterSeries[]` (`{ id, color?, data: { x, y, size?, label? }[] }[]`) | [charts/scatter.md](./charts/scatter.md) |
| Space-filling nested hierarchy proportional by area | `<mc-treemap-chart>` | `modern-charts/treemap` | `HierarchyNode` (`{ name, value?, color?, children? }`) | [charts/treemap.md](./charts/treemap.md) |
| Single KPI progress / radial dial with target & colored bands | `<mc-gauge-chart>` | `modern-charts/gauge` | `GaugeDatum` (`{ value, min?, max?, label?, unit?, target?, bands? }`) | [charts/gauge.md](./charts/gauge.md) |

# `modern-charts` Core Architecture & Shared Config Reference

Every chart component (`<mc-bar-chart>`, `<mc-line-chart>`, etc.) extends `MCBaseChart` and shares the exact same unified configuration model, sub-component architecture, label engine, marker/threshold engine, ARIA accessibility system, and composable layer pipeline.

---

## 1. Installation & Imports

```bash
npm install modern-charts
```

Runtime dependencies are strictly `d3` and `@chenglou/pretext`.

```js
// Recommended: standalone per-chart subpath import (registers ONLY that chart + shared core)
import 'modern-charts/bar';
import 'modern-charts/line';
import 'modern-charts/pie';
import 'modern-charts/heatmap';
import 'modern-charts/radar';
import 'modern-charts/sunburst';
import 'modern-charts/sankey';
import 'modern-charts/scatter';
import 'modern-charts/treemap';
import 'modern-charts/gauge';
import 'modern-charts/core'; // BaseChart, engines, and shared capability layers only

// Full library import (registers all 10 charts and supplies the complete `d3` namespace on `ctx.d3`)
import 'modern-charts';
```

### Feature Bootstrapping

Pass shared feature flags to `registerModernCharts()` or a per-chart registrar. `zoom` and `csvExport` default to `false`. `chartState` defaults to `true` and controls the loading and empty overlays. Explicit browser registration loads the enabled feature chunks. A side-effect import such as `import 'modern-charts/bar'` loads the state renderer the first time a chart displays a loading or empty overlay.

Set `features.chartState: false` during registration to skip the overlay download. A top-level `chartState: false` is also accepted as shorthand.

```js
import { registerBarChart } from 'modern-charts/bar';

await registerBarChart({ features: { chartState: false } });
```

With the overlay disabled, `chart.loading`, `chart.chartState`, the `mc-state-change` event, and `aria-busy` continue to work. Use `configureChartFeatures({ features: { chartState: true } })` to enable the overlay again. [Feature Bootstrapping guide](https://jingcai86.github.io/modern-charts/#/guide/bootstrapping) · [Loading & Empty States guide](https://jingcai86.github.io/modern-charts/#/guide/chart-state).

---

## 2. Shared `chart.config` Options (All 10 Charts)

Every chart accepts a single Nivo-style `chart.config = { ... }` object:

```ts
interface SharedChartConfig<TData> {
  data: TData;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  autoSize?: boolean; // default true (ResizeObserver); set false to use snapshot size + .resize()
  margin?: { top?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number; left?: number };
  title?: string;
  loading?: boolean; // default false
  loadingText?: string; // defaults to the localized loading message
  emptyText?: string; // defaults to the localized empty message
  i18n?: { locale?: string; timeZone?: string; direction?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'; messages?: Partial<ChartMessages> };

  // Composable Layer Pipeline (built-in names or custom functions/objects)
  layers?: Array<
    | string
    | ((ctx: ChartRenderContext<TData>) => SVGElement | string | void)
    | { name: string; render: (ctx: ChartRenderContext<TData>) => SVGElement | string | void }
  >;

  // Theme (<mc-theme-layer>)
  themeMode?: 'light' | 'dark' | 'system'; // default 'light'
  palette?: 'shadcn' | 'material' | 'bootstrap' | 'antd' | string; // 20-color built-in palette or seed color string (auto-generates >=20 light-to-dark colors)
  colors?: string[];
  theme?: Partial<ChartTheme>;

  // Scales (<mc-scale-layer>) — applicable to Cartesian charts (bar, line, scatter, heatmap)
  xScale?: {
    type?: 'linear' | 'point' | 'band' | 'time' | 'log' | 'symlog' | 'sqrt';
    min?: number | 'auto';
    max?: number | 'auto';
    reverse?: boolean;
    nice?: boolean;
    clamp?: boolean;
    padding?: number;
    innerPadding?: number;
    outerPadding?: number;
    base?: number;
    constant?: number;
  };
  yScale?: {
    type?: 'linear' | 'point' | 'band' | 'time' | 'log' | 'symlog' | 'sqrt';
    min?: number | 'auto';
    max?: number | 'auto';
    stacked?: boolean;
    reverse?: boolean;
    nice?: boolean;
    clamp?: boolean;
    base?: number;
    constant?: number;
  };

  // Pan & Zoom (<mc-view-layer>)
  view?: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    zoomable?: boolean;
    pannable?: boolean;
    minZoom?: number;
    maxZoom?: number;
    direction?: 'xy' | 'x' | 'y';
    showControls?: boolean; // Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset, and any slotted extra controls
    initialZoom?: number;
    initialPanX?: number;
    initialPanY?: number;
  };

  // Motion & Animation (<mc-animation-layer>)
  animate?: boolean; // default true (automatically respects prefers-reduced-motion)
  motionConfig?:
    | 'default'
    | 'gentle'
    | 'wobbly'
    | 'stiff'
    | 'slow'
    | 'molasses'
    | 'elastic'
    | 'bounce'
    | Partial<AnimationConfig>;
  animation?: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    duration?: number;
    easing?: 'cubic-out' | 'linear' | 'elastic-out' | 'back-out' | 'bounce-out' | 'quad-out';
    stagger?: number;
    streamDelay?: number;
  };

  // Markers & Thresholds (<mc-marker-layer> / <mc-marker>) — bar, line, scatter
  markers?: MarkerConfig[];

  // Universal Labels & Truncation (<mc-label> & <mc-truncate>, powered by @chenglou/pretext)
  enableLabels?: boolean;
  labelMode?: 'svg' | 'foreignObject' | 'custom';
  label?: Partial<LabelStyleOverride> | Partial<LabelStyleOverride>[];
  labelRenderer?: CustomLabelRenderer;
  labelOverflow?: 'truncate' | 'rotate' | 'both' | 'wrap' | 'wrap-truncate' | 'rotate-wrap-truncate' | 'none' | {
    strategy?: 'truncate' | 'rotate' | 'both' | 'wrap' | 'wrap-truncate' | 'rotate-wrap-truncate' | 'none'; // default 'truncate'
    maxWidth?: number;    // Pretext pixel width threshold
    maxChars?: number;    // grapheme character count threshold
    maxLines?: number;    // maximum lines in truncating modes
    ellipsis?: string;    // default '…'
    maxRotation?: number; // default 45 (supports negatives) for strategies that rotate
    enableTooltip?: boolean; // default true for truncated and automatically rotated labels
    tooltip?: boolean | TooltipConfig<LabelDescriptor>; // customizable full-text tooltip
  };

  // Unified Tooltip (<mc-tooltip> — one reusable instance per chart)
  tooltip?: boolean | {
    enabled?: boolean;
    position?: 'item' | 'follow'; // default 'item' (bar/scatter/radar/gauge) or 'follow' (line/pie/sunburst/heatmap/treemap/sankey)
    anchorGap?: number; // default 10 (px gap above/below item in 'item' mode)
    offsetX?: number;
    offsetY?: number;
    className?: string;
    formatter?: (payload: TooltipPayload) => string | null | undefined;
    renderer?: (payload: TooltipPayload, defaultRender: () => HTMLElement) => HTMLElement | DocumentFragment | string | null | undefined;
  };
  tooltipPosition?: 'item' | 'follow'; // shorthand also reflected via tooltip-position HTML attribute

  // Unified SVG Legend (<mc-legend>)
  legend?: boolean | {
    enabled?: boolean;
    type?: 'categorical' | 'continuous' | 'piecewise' | 'discrete';
    position?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'; // default 'bottom'
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    colorScheme?: string;
    steps?: number;
    // Heatmap color-legend appearance and labels
    align?: 'start' | 'middle' | 'end'; // default 'middle'
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    borderRadius?: number;
    blockGap?: number;
    labelPlacement?: 'ends' | 'ticks' | 'none';
    minLabel?: string;
    maxLabel?: string;
    tickFormat?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions | ((value: number) => string);
    padding?: number | { top?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number; left?: number };
    wrap?: boolean; // default true (Pretext-measured exact centering + row/column wrapping)
    enableTooltip?: boolean; // default true (hover + keyboard Tab focus dedicated legend tooltip)
    tooltip?: boolean | TooltipConfig<LegendItem>; // same customization shape as chart.config.tooltip
    itemGap?: number;
    rowGap?: number;
    swatchSize?: number;
    maxItemWidth?: number;
    fontSize?: number;
  };

  // Unified Event System (global + target-scoped callbacks for item, axis, legend, marker, title, label, canvas)
  events?: ChartEventsConfig;
  onClick?: ChartEventHandler;
  onFocus?: ChartEventHandler;
  onMouseOver?: ChartEventHandler;
  onMouseEnter?: ChartEventHandler;
  onMouseLeave?: ChartEventHandler;

  // W3C ARIA Accessibility (<mc-aria-layer> / <mc-aria>)
  role?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  ariaLabelledBy?: string;
  ariaDescribedBy?: string;
  isInteractive?: boolean; // default true; false renders a fully static chart (no tooltips, listeners, hover, or tabindex; overrides isFocusable)
  isFocusable?: boolean;   // default true; controls keyboard focus only when isInteractive is true (mouse-only: isInteractive: true, isFocusable: false)
  barAriaLabel?: string | ((item: AriaItemDescriptor) => string);
  pointAriaLabel?: string | ((item: AriaItemDescriptor) => string);
  arcAriaLabel?: string | ((item: AriaItemDescriptor) => string);
  cellAriaLabel?: string | ((item: AriaItemDescriptor) => string);
  nodeAriaLabel?: string | ((item: AriaItemDescriptor) => string);
  linkAriaLabel?: string | ((item: AriaItemDescriptor) => string);
  aria?: Partial<AriaConfig>;
}
```

### Shared HTML Attributes (All `<mc-*-chart>` Elements)

`width`, `height`, `auto-size`, `margin`, `theme-mode`, `palette`, `chart-title`, `layers`, `label-mode`, `label-overflow`, `tooltip-position`, `animate`, `motion-config`, `aria-label`, `is-interactive`, `is-focusable`, `loading`, `loading-text`, `empty-text`.

---

## 3. Markers & Threshold Styling (`markers` / `<mc-marker>`)

Supported on Cartesian charts (`<mc-bar-chart>`, `<mc-line-chart>`, `<mc-scatter-chart>`). Marker lines, areas, and inside labels have `pointer-events: none` so tooltips on underlying data items are never blocked, while outside `annotation` callouts have `pointer-events: auto` with interactive hover/focus tooltips enabled by default.

```ts
interface MarkerConfig {
  id?: string;
  type?: 'line' | 'area'; // default 'line'
  axis?: 'x' | 'y';       // default 'y'
  value?: number | string; // for type: 'line'
  from?: number | string;  // for type: 'area'
  to?: number | string;    // for type: 'area'
  label?: string;
  labelPosition?:
    | 'start' | 'middle' | 'end'
    | 'top-left' | 'top-center' | 'top-right'
    | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-center' | 'bottom-right';
  labelPadding?: number;     // px away from marker line/area edge for inside labels (default 10)
  labelEdgePadding?: number; // px inset from plot edge for inside labels (default 10)
  labelOffsetX?: number;
  labelOffsetY?: number;
  // Optional per-marker inside label styling (boxless text by default)
  labelStyle?: Partial<Omit<LabelStyleOverride, 'target'>>;
  icon?: string;
  // Outside callout (icon and/or text, boxless by default) placed where the mark line/area reaches the plot boundary
  annotation?: string | {
    text?: string;
    icon?: string | SVGElement | HTMLElement;
    position?: 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom'; // defaults to 'right' for axis:'y', 'top' for axis:'x'
    padding?: number;       // px gap outside plot edge (default 8)
    offsetX?: number;
    offsetY?: number;
    color?: string;
    background?: string;
    borderColor?: string;
    borderRadius?: number;
    fontSize?: number;
    fontWeight?: string | number;
    fontFamily?: string;
    labelPadding?: LabelPadding;
    formatter?: LabelStyleOverride['formatter'];
    renderer?: CustomLabelRenderer;
    enableTooltip?: boolean; // default true (hover + keyboard Tab focus)
    tooltip?: boolean | string | TooltipConfig<ResolvedMarker>;
  };
  // Include this line or area marker in the unified <mc-legend> (with hover/focus legend tooltip)
  legend?: boolean | {
    enabled?: boolean;
    label?: string;
    color?: string;
    swatch?: 'auto' | 'line' | 'area' | 'square';
    tooltip?: string;
  };
  stroke?: string;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  strokeDasharray?: string;
  fill?: string;
  fillOpacity?: number;
  condition?: 'below' | 'under' | 'lte' | 'above' | 'over' | 'gte' | 'between' | 'outside' | ((value: number, datum?: any) => boolean);
  matchScope?: 'partial' | 'item'; // default 'partial' (clips fill/stroke/dasharray at exact threshold boundary using single ARIA host + aria-hidden segments)
  matchStyle?: {
    color?: string;
    fill?: string;
    stroke?: string;
    strokeWidth?: number;
    opacity?: number;
    radius?: number;
    icon?: string;
    labelColor?: string;
  };
}
```

Note: When any marker defines an outside `annotation` (`left`, `right`, `top`, or `bottom`), `MCBaseChart` automatically expands the corresponding chart margin so the annotation never clips.

---

## 4. Universal Labels & Truncation (`<mc-label>`, `<mc-truncate>` & `LabelEngine`)

Every text label in every chart (ticks, titles, bar/point/arc/cell values, markers, legends, center labels) renders via `@chenglou/pretext` with zero DOM reflow.

Label overflow defaults to `'truncate'`. Select a strategy to control how long labels render.

- `'truncate'` fits text to its limits and adds an ellipsis when text is removed.
- `'rotate'` turns overflowing labels by `maxRotation`, which defaults to 45° and accepts negative angles.
- `'both'` combines rotation and truncation.
- `'wrap'` breaks the label into lines based on available width and keeps the full text.
- `'wrap-truncate'` wraps the label and applies character or line limits. Use this strategy when migrating an existing `'wrap'` config that relied on truncation.
- `'rotate-wrap-truncate'` adds automatic rotation to the wrapping and truncation mode.
- `'none'` leaves the label unchanged by automatic overflow handling.

Truncated and automatically rotated labels show the full text on hover and keyboard focus by default. Use `tooltip` to customize the tooltip or set `enableTooltip: false` to disable it.

Target types (`for` attribute on `<mc-label>` / `<mc-truncate>` or `target` in `config.label`):
`'all' | 'axis-tick' | 'axis-title' | 'data' | 'bar-outer' | 'arc' | 'arc-link' | 'cell' | 'radar-axis' | 'radar-point' | 'node' | 'link' | 'legend' | 'title' | 'center' | 'marker' | 'custom'`.

```html
<mc-bar-chart>
  <mc-label for="data" mode="foreignObject" bg-color="#0f172a" color="#f8fafc" border-radius="6" padding="4" icon="✨"></mc-label>
  <mc-truncate for="axis-tick" max-width="72" max-chars="14" strategy="both" max-rotation="-45"></mc-truncate>
</mc-bar-chart>

<!-- Reusable standalone component -->
<mc-truncate text="Quarterly Cloud Infrastructure Analysis" max-width="120" max-chars="20"></mc-truncate>
```

---

## 5. Custom Layers (`layers` & `<mc-custom-layer>`)

Insert custom SVG or D3 visuals at any z-index in `config.layers`:

```js
chart.config = {
  ...baseConfig,
  layers: [
    'grid',
    'axes',
    'bars',
    {
      name: 'avg-callout',
      render: (ctx) => {
        // Available on ctx: innerWidth, innerHeight, xScale, yScale, colorScale,
        // theme, data, markers, thresholds, layerGroup, svg, d3, renderLabel,
        // measureText, animateItem, decorateAriaItem, showTooltip, hideTooltip, state
        const y = ctx.yScale(150);
        const line = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'line');
        line.setAttribute('x1', '0');
        line.setAttribute('x2', String(ctx.innerWidth));
        line.setAttribute('y1', String(y));
        line.setAttribute('y2', String(y));
        line.setAttribute('stroke', '#f59e0b');
        line.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '6 4');
        ctx.layerGroup.appendChild(line);
      }
    },
    'labels',
    'legends'
  ]
};
```

---

## 6. AI Progressive Layer Streaming

For LLM interfaces that generate visualizations progressively:

```js
// Programmatic layer-by-layer reveal using animation.streamDelay (default 200ms)
await chart.streamLayers();

// Or stream specific layers one at a time via declarative children:
const layer = document.createElement('mc-chart-layer');
layer.setAttribute('name', 'bars');
chart.appendChild(layer);
```

---

## 7. Unified Tooltip (`<mc-tooltip>`) & CSS `::part()` Styling

Every chart owns strictly **one** `<mc-tooltip>` instance inside its Shadow DOM (reused in-place on pointer hover/move) and passes a structured `TooltipPayload` (`chartType`, `title`, `label`, `seriesId`, `category`, `value`, `formattedValue`, `color`, `percentage`, `badge`, `items[]`, `threshold`, `datum`, `data`).

- **Positioning modes (`item` vs `follow`)**: Configure via `chart.config.tooltip.position`, `chart.config.tooltipPosition`, HTML attribute `tooltip-position="item|follow"`, or `<mc-tooltip position="item|follow" anchor-gap="10">`. Per-chart defaults anchor on top of discrete items (`bar`, `scatter`, `radar`, `gauge`) and follow the cursor on continuous/radial/matrix/flow charts (`line`, `pie`, `sunburst`, `heatmap`, `treemap`, `sankey`), with automatic viewport/container edge flipping & clamping. Keyboard `Tab`/`Arrow` focus always anchors cleanly to the active item and dismisses on `Escape`/`blur`.
- **Customize via `chart.config.tooltip`**: `{ enabled, position, anchorGap, offsetX, offsetY, formatter, renderer }`.
- **Customize declaratively**: `<mc-tooltip position="item" offset-x="16"><template>{{title}}: {{value}}</template></mc-tooltip>`.
- **Style via CSS `::part()`**: `::part(tooltip)`, `::part(tooltip-header)`, `::part(tooltip-body)`, `::part(tooltip-row)`, `::part(tooltip-swatch)`, `::part(tooltip-label)`, `::part(tooltip-value)`, `::part(tooltip-badge)`.

---

## 8. Unified SVG Legend (`<mc-legend>`) & Dedicated Legend Tooltip

The unified legend serves categorical charts and heatmaps. Heatmaps default to a continuous gradient centered below the plot. Set `legend.type: 'discrete'` to color cells and legend blocks by the same value ranges. Set `legend.align` to place the color legend at the start, middle, or end of the selected side. See the [Heatmap color legend](./charts/heatmap.md#heatmap-color-legend) for sizing, labels, and range tooltips.

- **4 positions & 4-side padding**: `position: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'` and `padding: number | { top, right, bottom, left }` (with automatic margin reservation).
- **Categorical legend centering & wrapping**: `@chenglou/pretext` measures every legend label's exact dimensions so SVG legend rows (`top`/`bottom`) and columns (`left`/`right`) are centered accurately and wrap automatically by default (`wrap: false` disables wrapping).
- **Dedicated legend tooltip (hover + keyboard Tab)**: Hovering or Tab-focusing a legend item shows a separate singleton `<mc-tooltip class="mc-legend-tooltip">` (distinct from the chart item tooltip `.mc-tooltip`), disabled via `legend.enableTooltip: false` or `legend.tooltip: false`, and customizable via `chart.config.legend.tooltip` (`formatter`, `renderer`, `offsetX`, `offsetY`) or declarative `<mc-legend><mc-tooltip>...</mc-tooltip></mc-legend>`.
- **Style via CSS `::part()`**: `::part(legend-tooltip)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-header)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-body)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-row)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-swatch)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-label)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-value)`, `::part(legend-tooltip-badge)`.

---

## 9. Unified Event System (`config.events`, `.on()` / `.off()`, & `mc-*` CustomEvents)

Every chart region emits consistent `ChartEventPayload` objects across 13 event types (`click`, `dblclick`, `contextmenu`, `focus`, `blur`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `mousemove`, `pointerdown`, `pointerup`, `keydown`) via `config.events` (global + `item`/`axis`/`legend`/`marker`/`title`/`label`/`canvas` scopes), `chart.on()` / `chart.off()`, and composed DOM events (`mc-event`, `mc-<type>`, `mc-<category>-<type>`). Empty chart area interactions emit `target: 'canvas'`, `category: 'canvas'`, and strictly `data: undefined`.

---

## 10. Key Methods & Events

- `chart.render()` — Re-renders immediately.
- `chart.resize(width?, height?)` — Explicitly updates dimensions (especially when `autoSize: false`).
- `chart.on(eventName, handler)` / `chart.off(eventName, handler)` — Subscribe/unsubscribe to unified chart events (`'click'`, `'barItem:click'`, `'axis:click'`, `'legend:mouseenter'`, `'canvas:click'`, `'*'`).
- `chart.streamLayers(delayMs?)` — Streams layers progressively, firing `mc-layer-stream` per layer and `mc-stream-complete` on finish.
- `chart.getTooltipElement()` — Returns the chart's singleton item `<mc-tooltip>` instance.
- `chart.getLegendTooltipElement()` — Returns the chart's dedicated singleton legend `<mc-tooltip>` instance.
- `chart.chartState` — Reports `'ready'`, `'loading'`, or `'empty'` synchronously. Listen for `mc-state-change` to track transitions.
- `chart.toggleZoom(force?)` / `chart.setZoomEnabled(enabled)` — Change whether zoom is enabled and return the new state. Listen for `mc-zoom-toggle` to track it.
- `chart.zoomIn(factor?)` / `chart.zoomOut(factor?)` / `chart.resetZoom()` — Scale or reset the viewport when zoom is enabled.
- Events: `mc-event`, `mc-click`, `mc-focus`, `mc-blur`, `mc-mouseover`, `mc-mouseenter`, `mc-mouseleave`, `mc-item-*`, `mc-axis-*`, `mc-legend-*`, `mc-marker-*`, `mc-title-*`, `mc-canvas-*`, `mc-zoom`, `mc-aria-focus`, `mc-item-activate`, `mc-tooltip-show`, `mc-tooltip-hide`, `mc-legend-tooltip-show`, `mc-legend-tooltip-hide`, `mc-layer-stream`, `mc-stream-complete`.

---

## 11. Customizing Zoom Controls

Enable the zoom feature at registration with `{ features: { zoom: true } }`. Set `view.showControls: true` or use `<mc-view-layer show-controls>` to display **Zoom In**, **Zoom Out**, and **Reset**. `chart.toggleZoom()` remains available for programmatic control.

- Replace a button icon with a direct chart child such as an `<svg>` or `<img>` assigned to `zoom-in-icon`, `zoom-out-icon`, or `zoom-reset-icon`. The built-in button keeps its action and accessible name. Use `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative SVGs and `alt=""` on decorative images.
- Add a direct child `<button type="button" slot="zoom-controls-extra">` to place an action after the built-in buttons. Style it as ordinary page HTML and attach a click handler that calls a chart method.
- Style the built-in wrapper with `::part(controls)` and the three buttons with `::part(zoom-button)`. Target an individual button with `::part(zoom-in)`, `::part(zoom-out)`, or `::part(zoom-reset)`.

Add this example to an HTML page served by a JavaScript bundler with `modern-charts` installed.

```html
<style>
  #zoom-example::part(controls) { gap: 6px; }
  #zoom-example::part(zoom-button) { border-radius: 6px; }
  #zoom-example::part(zoom-reset) { font-weight: 700; }
  #zoom-example > button[slot="zoom-controls-extra"] { border-radius: 6px; }
</style>

<mc-bar-chart id="zoom-example" style="height: 300px">
  <svg slot="zoom-in-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3 8h10M8 3v10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />
  </svg>
  <button id="zoom-double" type="button" slot="zoom-controls-extra">Zoom 2×</button>
</mc-bar-chart>

<script type="module">
  import { registerBarChart } from 'modern-charts/bar';
  await registerBarChart({ features: { zoom: true } });

  const chart = document.querySelector('#zoom-example');
  chart.config = {
    data: [{ month: 'May', sales: 12 }, { month: 'June', sales: 18 }],
    indexBy: 'month',
    keys: ['sales'],
    view: { zoomable: true, showControls: true }
  };
  document.querySelector('#zoom-double').addEventListener('click', () => chart.zoomIn(2));
</script>
```

---

# `<mc-bar-chart>` — Bar & Stack Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-bar-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/bar';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCBarChart`, `MCBarItem`, `computeBarChartModel`, `registerBarChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['grid', 'axes', 'bars', 'markers', 'labels', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: Yes (`y` axis in vertical layout, `x` axis in horizontal layout)
- **Supports Cartesian Scales & View Zoom**: Yes (`xScale: band`, `yScale: linear`)

## Data Schema (`BarDatum[]`)

Array of flat objects where one key is the category (`indexBy`) and one or more keys hold numeric values (`keys`).

```ts
type BarDatum = Record<string, string | number>;
// Example:
const data: BarDatum[] = [
  { quarter: 'Q1', Cloud: 142, Edge: 94, OnPrem: 78 },
  { quarter: 'Q2', Cloud: 168, Edge: 118, OnPrem: 72 },
  { quarter: 'Q3', Cloud: 196, Edge: 145, OnPrem: 64 },
  { quarter: 'Q4', Cloud: 234, Edge: 172, OnPrem: 58 }
];
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `indexBy` | `index-by` | `string` | `'category'` | Category property key in each datum |
| `keys` | `keys` (comma-separated) | `string[]` | numeric keys inferred from row 0 | Series keys to plot |
| `groupMode` | `group-mode` | `'grouped' \| 'stacked'` | `'grouped'` | Side-by-side or stacked bars |
| `layout` | `layout` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | Bar orientation |
| `borderRadius` | `border-radius` | `number` | `5` | Corner radius (`rx`) in px |
| `enableLabels` | `enable-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Render value labels centered inside bars (coexists with `outerLabels`) |
| `outerLabels` | `enable-outer-labels`, `outer-label-scope`, `outer-label-position`, `negative-label-position`, `outer-label-padding` | `boolean \| BarOuterLabelConfig` | `{ enabled: false, scope: 'auto', position: 'auto', negativePosition: 'outside-bottom', padding: 8 }` | Outer / stack-summary labels above positive bars/stacks and below negative bars (`outside-bottom` \| `chart-bottom` \| `above-zero`); customizable via `formatter`, `renderer`, or `<mc-label for="bar-outer">` |
| `xTitle` | `x-title` | `string` | `undefined` | X-axis title |
| `yTitle` | `y-title` | `string` | `undefined` | Y-axis title |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-bar-chart id="bar" style="width: 100%; height: 380px;"></mc-bar-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/bar';

  document.getElementById('bar').config = {
    data: [
      { quarter: 'Q1', Cloud: 142, Edge: 94 },
      { quarter: 'Q2', Cloud: 168, Edge: 118 },
      { quarter: 'Q3', Cloud: 196, Edge: 145 }
    ],
    indexBy: 'quarter',
    keys: ['Cloud', 'Edge'],
    groupMode: 'grouped',
    layout: 'vertical',
    title: 'Quarterly Spend ($K)',
    xTitle: 'Quarter',
    yTitle: 'Spend ($K)',
    palette: 'shadcn',
    markers: [
      {
        id: 'floor',
        type: 'line',
        axis: 'y',
        value: 100,
        label: 'Target $100K',
        annotation: { text: '$100K', position: 'right', padding: 8 },
        legend: true,
        stroke: '#ef4444',
        condition: 'below',
        matchStyle: { color: '#ef4444' }
      }
    ],
    ariaLabel: 'Quarterly Cloud vs Edge Spend'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- Always set `indexBy` to match your category field name (default is `'category'`; omitting it when your rows use `'quarter'` or `'month'` will leave X-axis labels blank).
- For horizontal bars, set `layout: 'horizontal'` — `modern-charts` automatically swaps the band and linear scales.

---

# `<mc-line-chart>` — Line & Area Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-line-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/line';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCLineChart`, `MCLineItem`, `MCPointItem`, `computeLineChartModel`, `registerLineChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['grid', 'markers', 'axes', 'areas', 'lines', 'points', 'pointLabels', 'slices', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: Yes (including SVG gradient threshold split along the line path!)
- **Supports Cartesian Scales & View Zoom**: Yes (`xScale: point | time | linear`, `yScale: linear | log | symlog | sqrt`)

## Data Schema (`LineSeries[]`)

Array of series objects; each has `id`, optional `color`, and `data` array of `{ x, y, label? }` points.

```ts
interface LineSeries {
  id: string;
  color?: string;
  data: Array<{ x: string | number | Date; y: number; label?: string }>;
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `curve` | `curve` | `'monotoneX' \| 'linear' \| 'catmullRom' \| 'natural' \| 'step' \| 'stepAfter' \| 'stepBefore'` | `'monotoneX'` | D3 curve interpolation |
| `enableArea` | `enable-area` | `boolean` | `false` | Fill area beneath lines |
| `areaOpacity` | `area-opacity` | `number` (`0`–`1`) | `0.18` | Area fill opacity |
| `lineWidth` | `line-width` | `number` | `2.5` | Stroke width of lines in px |
| `pointSize` | `point-size` | `number` | `8` | Diameter of data point circles in px (`0` hides dots) |
| `enablePointLabels` | `enable-point-labels` | `boolean` | `false` | Show value labels above points |
| `enableSlices` | `enable-slices` | `boolean` | `true` | Vertical hover crosshair comparing all series at X |
| `xTitle` | `x-title` | `string` | `undefined` | X-axis title |
| `yTitle` | `y-title` | `string` | `undefined` | Y-axis title |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-line-chart id="line" style="width: 100%; height: 380px;"></mc-line-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/line';

  document.getElementById('line').config = {
    data: [
      {
        id: 'Revenue',
        data: [
          { x: 'Jan', y: 120 },
          { x: 'Feb', y: 145 },
          { x: 'Mar', y: 162 },
          { x: 'Apr', y: 190 }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: 'Forecast',
        data: [
          { x: 'Jan', y: 110 },
          { x: 'Feb', y: 138 },
          { x: 'Mar', y: 155 },
          { x: 'Apr', y: 175 }
        ]
      }
    ],
    curve: 'monotoneX',
    enableArea: true,
    areaOpacity: 0.2,
    yScale: { type: 'linear', stacked: false },
    title: 'Monthly Revenue vs Forecast',
    xTitle: 'Month',
    yTitle: 'USD ($K)',
    ariaLabel: 'Monthly revenue and forecast line chart'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- Data MUST be grouped by series (`LineSeries[]`), NOT flat rows like `<mc-bar-chart>`.
- For stacked area charts, set both `enableArea: true` and `yScale: { stacked: true }`.
- For `Date` X values, set `xScale: { type: 'time' }`.

---

# `<mc-pie-chart>` — Pie & Donut Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-pie-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/pie';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCPieChart`, `MCArcItem`, `computePieChartModel`, `registerPieChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['arcs', 'arcLabels', 'arcLinkLabels', 'center', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: No
- **Supports Cartesian Scales**: No

## Data Schema (`PieDatum[]`)

```ts
interface PieDatum {
  id: string;
  label?: string;
  value: number;
  color?: string;
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `innerRadius` | `inner-radius` | `number` (`0`–`0.9`) | `0.52` | Inner hole ratio (`0` = full pie, `0.52` = donut) |
| `padAngle` | `pad-angle` | `number` (degrees) | `~1.15` (`0.02 rad`) | Angular gap between slices |
| `cornerRadius` | `corner-radius` | `number` | `5` | Rounded corner radius on slice arcs |
| `centerLabel` | `center-label` | `string` | `'Total\n<sum>'` | Center text inside donut hole (shown when inner radius >= 25px) |
| — | `enable-arc-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Percentage labels inside slices |
| — | `enable-arc-link-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | External callout leader lines & labels |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-pie-chart id="pie" style="width: 100%; height: 380px;"></mc-pie-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/pie';

  document.getElementById('pie').config = {
    data: [
      { id: 'Compute', label: 'Compute', value: 420 },
      { id: 'Storage', label: 'Storage', value: 260 },
      { id: 'Network', label: 'Network', value: 180 },
      { id: 'AI', label: 'AI / GPU', value: 340 }
    ],
    innerRadius: 0.56,
    cornerRadius: 6,
    padAngle: 2,
    title: 'Cloud Cost Breakdown',
    palette: 'shadcn',
    ariaLabel: 'Cloud cost breakdown donut chart'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- `innerRadius` is a **ratio** between `0` and `0.9` (not pixels). Use `0` for a solid pie or `0.5`–`0.7` for a donut.
- Ensure negative values are not passed (slices clamp `value` at `>= 0`).

---

# `<mc-heatmap-chart>` — Matrix Heatmap Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-heatmap-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/heatmap';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCHeatmapChart`, `MCCellItem`, `computeHeatmapChartModel`, `registerHeatmapChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['axes', 'cells', 'labels', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: No
- **Supports Cartesian Scales**: Band X & Band Y + sequential color scale

## Data Schema (`HeatmapRow[]`)

Array of row objects where `id` is the Y-axis row label and `data` contains `{ x, y }` cells (`x` = column key, `y` = numeric intensity).

```ts
interface HeatmapRow {
  id: string;
  data: Array<{ x: string; y: number }>;
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `colorScheme` | `color-scheme` | `'viridis' \| 'plasma' \| 'inferno' \| 'magma' \| 'cividis' \| 'turbo' \| 'warm' \| 'cool' \| 'blues' \| 'greens' \| 'oranges' \| 'purples' \| 'ylGnBu' \| 'rdYlBu' \| 'spectral'` | `'viridis'` | D3 sequential/diverging color interpolator |
| `cellShape` | `cell-shape` | `'rect' \| 'circle'` | `'rect'` | Cell marker geometry |
| `cellPadding` | `cell-padding` | `number` (`0`–`0.5`) | `0.1` | Padding ratio between cells |
| `borderRadius` | `border-radius` | `number` | `6` | Corner radius for `'rect'` cells |
| `enableLabels` | `enable-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Render numeric value inside each cell |

## Heatmap Color Legend

The heatmap color legend appears centered below the plot by default. Set `chart.config.legend` or add a direct `<mc-legend>` child to customize it. Continuous mode uses a smooth gradient. Discrete mode divides the color domain into `steps` equal ranges and gives the cells and their legend blocks the same colors.

| Config key under `legend` | `<mc-legend>` attribute | Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `type` | `type` | `'continuous'` (default) or `'discrete'`. |
| `enabled` | `enabled` | Show the color legend. Defaults to `true`. |
| `steps` | `steps` | Number of discrete color blocks (`1`–`100`). Defaults to `10`. |
| `min`, `max` | `min`, `max` | Override the shared color domain. Otherwise, the chart bounds or the data bounds apply. |
| `colorScheme` | `color-scheme` | Override the ramp for both the cells and the legend. |
| `position` | `position` | `'bottom'` (default), `'top'`, `'left'`, or `'right'`. |
| `align` | `align` | `'start'`, `'middle'` (default), or `'end'` along the chosen side. Start and end are left and right on horizontal legends, and top and bottom on vertical legends, regardless of text direction. |
| `width`, `height` | `width`, `height` | Requested SVG dimensions in pixels, bounded by available space. Omit for position-specific sizing. |
| `borderRadius`, `blockGap` | `border-radius`, `block-gap` | Corner radius (default `4px`) and spacing between discrete blocks (default `2px`). Both accept `0`. |
| `labelPlacement` | `label-placement` | `'ends'` (default), `'ticks'` for discrete range boundaries, or `'none'`. Continuous mode uses end labels unless set to `'none'`. |
| `minLabel`, `maxLabel` | `min-label`, `max-label` | Custom text at the ends of the legend. |
| `tickFormat` | `tick-format` | Locale-aware `Intl.NumberFormatOptions`, such as `{ maximumFractionDigits: 1 }`. Use a JSON object in HTML. JavaScript also accepts `(value) => string`. |
| `fontSize`, `padding` | `font-size`, `padding` | Label font size (default `10px`) and outer spacing in pixels. Config padding accepts a number or an object with `top`, `right`, `bottom`, and `left`. |
| `enableTooltip`, `tooltip` | `enable-tooltip`, nested `<mc-tooltip>` | Show a dedicated legend tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Set `enableTooltip: false` or `tooltip: false` to hide it. |

Each discrete range includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound. The last range also includes the domain maximum. Values outside the domain take the nearest end color. Set `legend.enabled: false` or remove `'legends'` from `layers` to hide the legend while keeping the cell colors.

Each discrete legend tooltip receives the range on `datum.meta`, with numeric `min`, `max`, and boolean `maxInclusive`.

```ts
chart.config = {
  ...chart.config,
  legend: {
    type: 'discrete',
    position: 'bottom',
    align: 'start',
    min: 0,
    max: 100,
    steps: 5,
    width: 240,
    height: 14,
    borderRadius: 3,
    blockGap: 2,
    labelPlacement: 'ticks',
    tickFormat: { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 },
    tooltip: {
      formatter: ({ datum }) => {
        const range = datum?.meta;
        if (!range) return undefined;
        return `${range.min}% ≤ load ${range.maxInclusive ? '≤' : '<'} ${range.max}%`;
      }
    }
  }
};
```

The corresponding declarative legend goes inside `<mc-heatmap-chart>`.

```html
<mc-legend type="discrete" position="bottom" align="start" min="0" max="100" steps="5"
  width="240" height="14" border-radius="3" block-gap="2"
  label-placement="ticks"
  tick-format='{"minimumFractionDigits":1,"maximumFractionDigits":1}'></mc-legend>
```

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-heatmap-chart id="hm" style="width: 100%; height: 380px;"></mc-heatmap-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/heatmap';

  document.getElementById('hm').config = {
    data: [
      { id: 'Mon', data: [{ x: '09:00', y: 24 }, { x: '12:00', y: 78 }, { x: '15:00', y: 65 }] },
      { id: 'Tue', data: [{ x: '09:00', y: 31 }, { x: '12:00', y: 92 }, { x: '15:00', y: 54 }] },
      { id: 'Wed', data: [{ x: '09:00', y: 18 }, { x: '12:00', y: 61 }, { x: '15:00', y: 88 }] }
    ],
    colorScheme: 'viridis',
    cellShape: 'rect',
    borderRadius: 6,
    enableLabels: true,
    title: 'API Load by Day & Hour',
    ariaLabel: 'API load heatmap matrix'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- Each cell uses `{ x: '<column>', y: <number> }` (NOT `value`).
- `colorScheme` is case-sensitive for `'ylGnBu'` and `'rdYlBu'`.

---

# `<mc-radar-chart>` — Radar / Spider Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-radar-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/radar';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCRadarChart`, `MCRadarItem`, `computeRadarChartModel`, `registerRadarChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['grid', 'axes', 'layers', 'dots', 'labels', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: No
- **Supports Cartesian Scales**: No (polar radial scale)

## Data Schema (`RadarDatum[]`)

Array of metric rows where `indexBy` names the radial spoke/axis and `keys` are the series compared across every spoke.

```ts
type RadarDatum = Record<string, string | number>;
// Example:
const data: RadarDatum[] = [
  { metric: 'Speed', ModelA: 92, ModelB: 78 },
  { metric: 'Accuracy', ModelA: 88, ModelB: 94 },
  { metric: 'Cost', ModelA: 84, ModelB: 70 },
  { metric: 'Context', ModelA: 95, ModelB: 82 },
  { metric: 'Safety', ModelA: 90, ModelB: 89 }
];
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `indexBy` | `index-by` | `string` | `'metric'` | Property naming each spoke axis |
| `keys` | `keys` (comma-separated) | `string[]` | numeric keys inferred from row 0 | Series polygons to plot |
| `gridLevels` | `grid-levels` | `number` | `5` | Concentric grid rings |
| `gridShape` | `grid-shape` | `'circular' \| 'linear'` | `'circular'` | Circular rings vs polygonal web |
| `fillOpacity` | `fill-opacity` | `number` (`0`–`1`) | `0.24` | Polygon fill opacity |
| `enableDots` | `enable-dots` | `boolean` | `true` | Render dots at polygon vertices |
| `enableDotLabels` | `enable-dot-labels` | `boolean` | `false` | Render numeric value labels at dots |
| — | `max-value` | `number` | auto max | Fixed outer radial max value |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-radar-chart id="radar" style="width: 100%; height: 400px;"></mc-radar-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/radar';

  document.getElementById('radar').config = {
    data: [
      { metric: 'Speed', Alpha: 92, Beta: 76 },
      { metric: 'Quality', Alpha: 88, Beta: 95 },
      { metric: 'Efficiency', Alpha: 85, Beta: 72 },
      { metric: 'Reliability', Alpha: 94, Beta: 89 },
      { metric: 'UX', Alpha: 90, Beta: 84 }
    ],
    indexBy: 'metric',
    keys: ['Alpha', 'Beta'],
    gridShape: 'circular',
    gridLevels: 5,
    fillOpacity: 0.25,
    title: 'Benchmark Profile',
    ariaLabel: 'Alpha vs Beta radar benchmark'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- The polygon layer is named `'layers'` (NOT `'polygons'`) in `defaultLayers`: `['grid', 'axes', 'layers', 'dots', 'labels', 'legends']`.
- Always provide at least 3 rows (axes) for a readable polygon.

---

# `<mc-sunburst-chart>` — Sunburst Hierarchy Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-sunburst-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/sunburst';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCSunburstChart`, `MCArcItem`, `computeSunburstChartModel`, `registerSunburstChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['arcs', 'labels', 'center', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: No
- **Supports Interactive Drilldown**: Yes (click any parent arc to drill in; click center circle to drill up, or call `chart.resetDrilldown()`)

## Data Schema (`HierarchyNode`)

Single root tree node. Leaf nodes carry numeric `value`; parent nodes derive their value from the sum of descendants.

```ts
interface HierarchyNode {
  name: string;
  value?: number;
  color?: string;
  children?: HierarchyNode[];
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `cornerRadius` | `corner-radius` | `number` | `3` | Corner radius on partition arcs |
| `enableLabels` | `enable-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Render Pretext-wrapped labels inside arcs that have enough room |
| `interactiveDrilldown` | `interactive-drilldown` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow clicking arcs / center circle to zoom hierarchy |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-sunburst-chart id="sunburst" style="width: 100%; height: 420px;"></mc-sunburst-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/sunburst';

  document.getElementById('sunburst').config = {
    data: {
      name: 'Cloud',
      children: [
        {
          name: 'Compute',
          children: [
            { name: 'GPU', value: 320 },
            { name: 'CPU', value: 180 }
          ]
        },
        {
          name: 'Storage',
          children: [
            { name: 'Object', value: 140 },
            { name: 'Block', value: 95 }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    cornerRadius: 4,
    interactiveDrilldown: true,
    title: 'Infrastructure Hierarchy',
    ariaLabel: 'Cloud infrastructure sunburst hierarchy'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- `data` is a **single `HierarchyNode` object** (NOT an array).
- Put `value` on **leaf nodes** only; parent nodes with `children` ignore their own `value` so totals are never double-counted.

---

# `<mc-sankey-chart>` — Sankey Flow Diagram

- **Tag**: `<mc-sankey-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/sankey';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCSankeyChart`, `MCSankeyNodeItem`, `MCSankeyLinkItem`, `computeSankeyChartModel`, `registerSankeyChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['links', 'nodes', 'labels', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: No
- **Supports Cartesian Scales**: No (directed acyclic graph column layout)

## Data Schema (`SankeyData`)

Object with `nodes` and `links`. Every `link.source` and `link.target` MUST match an `id` in `nodes`.

```ts
interface SankeyData {
  nodes: Array<{ id: string; name?: string; color?: string }>;
  links: Array<{ source: string; target: string; value: number; color?: string }>;
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `nodeWidth` | `node-width` | `number` | `18` | Node rectangle width in px |
| `nodePadding` | `node-padding` | `number` | `16` | Vertical gap between nodes in px |
| `linkOpacity` | `link-opacity` | `number` (`0`–`1`) | `0.42` | Default stroke opacity of gradient flow links |
| `enableLabels` | `enable-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Render node labels next to each node |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-sankey-chart id="sankey" style="width: 100%; height: 400px;"></mc-sankey-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/sankey';

  document.getElementById('sankey').config = {
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'organic', name: 'Organic Search' },
        { id: 'paid', name: 'Paid Ads' },
        { id: 'signup', name: 'Signups' },
        { id: 'pro', name: 'Pro Plan' },
        { id: 'free', name: 'Free Tier' }
      ],
      links: [
        { source: 'organic', target: 'signup', value: 420 },
        { source: 'paid', target: 'signup', value: 280 },
        { source: 'signup', target: 'pro', value: 210 },
        { source: 'signup', target: 'free', value: 490 }
      ]
    },
    nodeWidth: 18,
    nodePadding: 16,
    linkOpacity: 0.45,
    title: 'User Acquisition Funnel',
    ariaLabel: 'User acquisition Sankey flow diagram'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- `links` must form a **DAG** (no cycles) and every `source` / `target` must reference an existing `nodes[].id`.
- `link.value` must be positive (`> 0`).

---

# `<mc-scatter-chart>` — Scatter & Bubble Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-scatter-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/scatter';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCScatterChart`, `MCScatterItem`, `computeScatterChartModel`, `registerScatterChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['grid', 'markers', 'axes', 'trendline', 'nodes', 'labels', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: Yes (`y` axis threshold restyling)
- **Supports Cartesian Scales & View Zoom**: Yes (`xScale: linear`, `yScale: linear`)

## Data Schema (`ScatterSeries[]`)

Array of series objects; each point has numeric `x`, `y`, optional `size` (maps via `scaleSqrt` to bubble radius), and optional `label` / `id`.

```ts
interface ScatterSeries {
  id: string;
  color?: string;
  data: Array<{ x: number; y: number; size?: number; label?: string; id?: string }>;
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `minNodeSize` | `min-node-size` | `number` | `6` | Minimum circle radius in px |
| `maxNodeSize` | `max-node-size` | `number` | `18` | Maximum circle radius in px (used when `point.size` is provided) |
| `enableLabels` | `enable-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Show point labels when `point.label` or `point.id` is set |
| `enableTrendline` | `enable-trendline` | `boolean` | `false` | Overlay ordinary least-squares linear regression line |
| `xTitle` | `x-title` | `string` | `undefined` | X-axis title |
| `yTitle` | `y-title` | `string` | `undefined` | Y-axis title |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-scatter-chart id="scatter" style="width: 100%; height: 400px;"></mc-scatter-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/scatter';

  document.getElementById('scatter').config = {
    data: [
      {
        id: 'Cluster A',
        data: [
          { x: 18, y: 42, size: 120, label: 'Svc-1' },
          { x: 35, y: 68, size: 240, label: 'Svc-2' },
          { x: 52, y: 84, size: 190, label: 'Svc-3' }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: 'Cluster B',
        data: [
          { x: 26, y: 31, size: 90, label: 'Svc-4' },
          { x: 64, y: 76, size: 310, label: 'Svc-5' }
        ]
      }
    ],
    enableTrendline: true,
    minNodeSize: 6,
    maxNodeSize: 18,
    title: 'Latency vs Throughput',
    xTitle: 'Throughput (kRPS)',
    yTitle: 'P95 Latency (ms)',
    ariaLabel: 'Latency vs throughput scatter bubble chart'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- Both `x` and `y` must be numeric (`number`).
- To render a uniform scatter plot (fixed radii), omit `size` on points or set `minNodeSize === maxNodeSize`.

---

# `<mc-treemap-chart>` — Squarified Treemap Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-treemap-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/treemap';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCTreemapChart`, `MCCellItem`, `computeTreemapChartModel`, `registerTreemapChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['tiles', 'labels', 'legends']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: No
- **Supports Cartesian Scales**: No (D3 squarified hierarchical tiling)

## Data Schema (`HierarchyNode`)

Single root tree node (same `HierarchyNode` schema as `<mc-sunburst-chart>`). Leaf nodes carry numeric `value`.

```ts
interface HierarchyNode {
  name: string;
  value?: number;
  color?: string;
  children?: HierarchyNode[];
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tilePadding` | `tile-padding` | `number` | `4` | Inner padding in px between tiles |
| `borderRadius` | `border-radius` | `number` | `6` | Corner radius (`rx`) of each tile |
| `enableLabels` | `enable-labels` | `boolean` | `true` | Render Pretext-wrapped labels inside tiles (`width >= 36 && height >= 22`) |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-treemap-chart id="treemap" style="width: 100%; height: 400px;"></mc-treemap-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/treemap';

  document.getElementById('treemap').config = {
    data: {
      name: 'Budget',
      children: [
        {
          name: 'Engineering',
          children: [
            { name: 'Platform', value: 420 },
            { name: 'AI Research', value: 380 },
            { name: 'Security', value: 190 }
          ]
        },
        {
          name: 'Product',
          children: [
            { name: 'Design', value: 210 },
            { name: 'Analytics', value: 160 }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    tilePadding: 4,
    borderRadius: 6,
    enableLabels: true,
    title: 'Department Budget Allocation',
    ariaLabel: 'Department budget allocation treemap'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- `data` is a **single `HierarchyNode` object** (NOT an array).
- The tile layer is named `'tiles'` in `defaultLayers`: `['tiles', 'labels', 'legends']`.
- Put `value` on leaf nodes only.

---

# `<mc-gauge-chart>` — Radial KPI Gauge Chart

- **Tag**: `<mc-gauge-chart>`
- **Subpath Import**: `import 'modern-charts/gauge';`
- **Class / Item Exports**: `MCGaugeChart`, `MCArcItem`, `computeGaugeChartModel`, `registerGaugeChart`
- **Default Layers**: `['track', 'bands', 'valueArc', 'ticks', 'needle', 'center']`
- **Supports Markers/Thresholds**: Uses `bands` (`GaugeBand[]`) on `GaugeDatum`
- **Supports Cartesian Scales**: No (radial 270° arc scale)

## Data Schema (`GaugeDatum`)

Single KPI datum object (NOT an array).

```ts
interface GaugeBand {
  from: number;
  to: number;
  color: string;
  label?: string;
}

interface GaugeDatum {
  value: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  label?: string;
  unit?: string;
  target?: number;
  bands?: GaugeBand[];
}
```

## Chart-Specific Config Options & Attributes

| `chart.config` Key | HTML Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `min` | `min` | `number` | `datum.min ?? 0` | Minimum gauge value |
| `max` | `max` | `number` | `datum.max ?? 100` | Maximum gauge value |
| `unit` | `unit` | `string` | `datum.unit ?? ''` | Unit suffix appended to center readout (e.g. `'%'`, `'ms'`) |

## Minimal Working Example

```html
<mc-gauge-chart id="gauge" style="width: 100%; height: 340px;"></mc-gauge-chart>
<script type="module">
  import 'modern-charts/gauge';

  document.getElementById('gauge').config = {
    data: {
      value: 78,
      min: 0,
      max: 100,
      unit: '%',
      label: 'Cluster Health',
      bands: [
        { from: 0, to: 50, color: '#ef4444', label: 'Critical' },
        { from: 50, to: 80, color: '#f59e0b', label: 'Warning' },
        { from: 80, to: 100, color: '#10b981', label: 'Healthy' }
      ]
    },
    title: 'SLO Attainment',
    ariaLabel: 'Cluster health radial gauge at 78%'
  };
</script>
```

## Common Pitfalls

- `data` is a **single `GaugeDatum` object** (NOT an array).
- `value` is automatically clamped to `[min, max]`.
- `bands[].from` and `bands[].to` must lie within `[min, max]`.
